data.body: **P2 — Preserve compatibility with pre-`toBuilder` test runners.** An older `LocalDurableTestRunner` copies the already-resolved plugin list into a fresh builder. With an environment-selected new OTel view, this branch discovers a second instance and the new group validation rejects runner construction. Thus updating core/plugin while retaining the older testing artifact breaks previously valid tests. Add the old-testing/new-core compatibility case and either permit same-view duplicates in this compatible release or defer that stricter rule to a breaking release.
